title: Victoria Highlights Private Half-Day Tour
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
This is an experiential tour that combines an up-close and personal guided walking tour. Private tour - just you with our fun and informative guide. Very personalized tour. A lovely fish and chips lunch is included in the tour at charming Fisherman's Wharf.
We are able to pick you up at your hotel or at the cruise ship terminal.
